topic: Corazon took the Ope Ope Fruit's price onto himself so Law never had to pay it
title: Corazon Didn't Save Law, He Paid Law's Price
description: The Ope Ope Fruit grants eternal life, but its surgeon pays with his own. Corazon forced it on Law in chapter 766 and hid him in chapter 767, and here's why I think he paid Law's price. Do you buy it?
comment: Was Corazon's gift a rescue or a trade? Pick one, and tell me which chapter proves it.

lines.text: Corazon didn't save Law. He paid Law's bill.

shot.search: Corazon Law Ope Ope no Mi
shot.fallback: a clown-painted man in a feathered coat holding a boy

lines.text: Its strongest power is the Perennial Youth Operation: eternal life.

shot.fallback: surgeon inside a glowing blue dome

lines.text: But the surgeon who performs it spends his own life doing it.

shot.search: Law Room operating Ope Ope no Mi
shot.fallback: surgeon exhausted inside a glowing dome

lines.text: Doflamingo knew that. It's the whole reason he wanted the fruit.

shot.search: Doflamingo Ope Ope no Mi plan

lines.text: And as I read it, he planned to make Law the one holding the scalpel.

shot.fallback: laughing pirate looking at a sick boy

lines.text: Then chapter 766 hits. Corazon steals that fruit for a thirteen-year-old.

shot.search: Rosinante forces Law eat Ope Ope no Mi
shot.fallback: tall man pressing a fruit into a boy's hands

lines.text: Chapter 767: he hides Law in a chest and uses his silence to cover the escape.

shot.search: Rosinante Law treasure chest Nagi Nagi no Mi
shot.fallback: boy hidden in a treasure chest, snowy port

lines.text: People say he only wanted a sick kid cured. Half right, but look at who ends up holding the price.

shot.fallback: two brothers facing each other in snow

lines.text: Here's my read: Corazon took that price onto himself, so Law never had to pay it.

shot.fallback: man smiling at a boy, snow falling

lines.text: Law builds his life on it: the Heart Pirates, the smiling flag, even his Silent technique.

shot.search: Heart Pirates Jolly Roger Corazon smile
shot.fallback: pirate flag with a smiling heart

lines.text: He didn't inherit a power. He inherited a bill that someone else had already paid.

shot.search: Law Corazon memory Ope Ope no Mi
shot.fallback: pirate surgeon remembering a smiling man

lines.text: That's the part everyone misses, because the truth is...

shot.search: Trafalgar Law Heart Pirates Polar Tang
shot.fallback: pirate surgeon with spotted hat looking back

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim naming Corazon and Law in the first sentence.
self_check.loop: Last line trails into line 1: the truth is... Corazon didn't save Law. He paid Law's bill.
